name: search_claims
description: Keyword search across the other claims in the database: their recorded overview and outcome and every event of their history. Returns matching excerpts with the claim id and where they come from. Returns "No claim found" if nothing matches.

name: read_claim
description: Read one other claim in full by its id from the list, e.g. "insurance-017": case details, recorded overview and outcome, and the whole event history.
